summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for expert auth hardening, OTP/Twilio secure contract, weather/maps behavior, Aadhaar demo behavior, notifications, packaging, and build checks on public preview URL.

minor.issue: Shared preview rate-limit (429) intermittently blocked repeated automated expert-login attempts during one pytest run; tests were guarded/skipped when throttled.

action_items: Optionally add deterministic fixture coverage for legacy expert-token rejection (`auth_method` mismatch) using in-process DB/session setup, since this was not validated via public API only.
Resolve frontend lint warnings (`react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`) in `useNotifications.ts` and `useWeather.ts`.
If needed for CI stability, isolate auth rate-limit sensitive tests by fresh IP bucket or single-login fixture strategy.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/memory/test_credentials.md` is present but empty; QA had to provision a new isolated expert identity for this run.
Source archive smoke test passed after setting required env keys from example/local values; import fails fast as expected when required env keys (e.g., MONGO_URL/DEMO_OTP) are absent.
Google Maps live path remains intentionally unverified without a real browser key; OSM fallback was validated.
Twilio live SMS remains intentionally unverified without credentials; fail-closed behavior (503) and adapter fixture tests were validated.
seed_data_creation: Created one isolated QA expert account and QA farmer-generated fields/uploads/advisories via public APIs. Cleaned up the specific QA expert account and its sessions after test execution; no broad cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile screenshots captured for required flows: farmer login + Aadhaar demo, expert login, notifications, GPS/location map/weather, camera long-query. Packaging rebuilt (`sahaayak-local.zip`, 171 files) and extraction/import smoke validated with example-style env values. Docker engine execution was not run in this pass. QA expert credentials file was removed after account cleanup.
rca of the issue: No blocking functional regression found in scoped features. The only execution friction was auth rate-limiting in shared preview, which is environmental test-throttling rather than business logic failure. OTP behavior is fail-closed by design when Twilio is unconfigured; expert demo bypass removal and expert-login redirect flow are functioning as intended.
test_credentials: `/app/memory/test_credentials.md` had no usable credentials; created isolated QA expert for this run and removed it after testing.
mocked_integrations: MOCKED: Twilio live SMS (fixtures/contract tested only), Google Maps live key path (OSM fallback tested), Aadhaar endpoint is demo-only by design (`verified=false`).
